title: [Refurb] Apple iPhone 13 128GB $379 Delivered + Handling Fees @ Coles
body:
Deal: [Refurb] Apple iPhone 13 128GB $379 Delivered + Handling Fees @ Coles

[The1Warden] Bring it down to $359 using promo: ONLINE20 at checkout
[ForkSnorter] $379 for a 2nd hand, 4-year-old base-model iphone. Nah
[Zackeroo] "A base model Ferrari is still a base model"
~ Confucius
[huu] "A base model Ferrari is still a Ferrari”
~ Confucius
[The1Warden] @huu: "There are no accidents"
~ Master Oogway
[PRao] @The1Warden: "An accident with a base model Ferrari, an accident it still is."
~ Master Yoda
[DogeConomy] Quoted in verbatim:
base-model iphone
get your facts straight lol
[George Washington] “Know your Ferrari and know the road.“-Sun Tzu
[taki] @George Washington: Or check your unconscious fantasy 🤡💥 This base model is inferior to any Android with AI capabilities. Good luck ;)
[bargaino] FYI, base model of that generation is the SE3 - same SoC and 4GB ram, but IPS display, single camera, and only 64GB storage. $259.00
[g12345567] The iPhone 13 lineup included four distinct models: iPhone 13 mini, iPhone 13, iPhone 13 Pro, and iPhone 13 Pro Max. This being the second cheapest in the 13 series coming with 4gb ram and 128gb storage. Yet still considered premium with a list price of $1,349 in Australia when first release September 24, 2021.
[taki] I pay $5.62*12m=$135 (Voda plan extra phone) for new 3'24 model Galaxy A55 with 8G RAM for capable & good AI. iPhone13 is outdated & >3x more expensive ;)🤡💥
[Kyriasa] I'm legitimately interested if you had a link to a equivalent refurbished that's cheaper. In the market for one.
[HaydosK] @Kyriasa: Well these "referbished" phones can vary in quality alot. Getting a used phone from marketplace and fixing the battery yourself or at a repair shop would be cheaper and a better deal.
[yeahna] @HaydosK: @HaydosK You must have access to a different marketplace to the one I can see, because mine has them for sale $300-$600 (unless you're happy to pay $220 for a device with "minor cracks").
[HaydosK] @yeahna: Iphone 13 for $600 is literally insanity. I see iphone 15 pro max go for that price on marketplace.
[Daabido] @HaydosK: Hot, broken, or didn't happen.
[HaydosK] @Daabido: No not broken. Just needs to replace the battery. Broken ones are cheaper.
[Kyriasa] @HaydosK: I'm not the one negging you. Appreciated the reply, was hoping to get a refurb as I wasn't keen on going the replacement path.
[HaydosK] @Kyriasa: I don't hate refurbished but if apple isn't doing the refurb they are going to be using the same 3rd party parts as other places so it's more paying for convenience. I just feel like ozbargainers would be happy to go out and get a better deal. Also some refurb places use terrible parts and screens on refurbs while that can be avoided with an honest repair shop.
[HaydosK] @HaydosK: Also another thing is I would only buy iphone 14 (excluding 14 pro series) and later at this point. Earlier models have more expensive back glass replacement and iphone 15 and newer are USB-C. Iphone 13 should not cost more than $250 tbh.
[Ploy2935] Can I just go into the store and grab one from the service desk, or do I have to get it delivered?
[LuckyLuke] From what I remember, it is not actually coles that sells them, it is like 'coles marketplace' - so yes, it will be delivered
[Dishcloth] Luke, make sure you bypass the Androids. These aren't the droids you're looking for.
The Apple phone is only available in store if you take them by force.
Use the force, Luke.
[Ipodisclassic] As someone who’s bought these phones previously stores will get stock but it’s kind of random and these specials are usually popular. Better to call ahead and then go pickup immediately when you find one that has stock. Placing an order for click and collect will usually get cancelled due to unavailability.
[raytriplej] ring ahead, the first store in Cairns had none, the second store had enough stock to choose between colours
[TaylorN] I just bought one in store, they let me order online with the $20 discount, then they pushed it through click & collect, picked it up 5 minutes later.
[tars19] Is there a minimum battery life that you would expect to receive?
[netsurfer] 70%, then needing to return it. Battery life on these is a lottery. If it is too high, is it original or 3rd party?
[Craze] Was cheaper previously . I got one for parents from this deal , was a Japan model and in pretty good condition, couldn't fault it really. Battery health was around 80% so borderline, but if you're after iPhone and a basic user I think it serves it's purpose.
[happychappy1] You'd be better of getting a new motorola for this price.
[raytriplej] Even though Amaysim have the Samsung A37 5G at $349, I bought this iPhone 13 as a cheap backup.
[skyboy] Just grab one from local Coles for the kid, down to $341 with 10% off Flybuys offer. But there is a scratch on the screen. I think it still’s a good deal for the kid’s phone.
[skyboy] There is a 10% off over $70 in my Flybuys account, which expired today.
[Hugh G Rection] great price, but i can't go back to lightning cables as i threw them all away.
[werdplaya58] So the description on the Coles site claims the refurbished phone is in 'excellent' condition but comments on here from previous deals suggest otherwise.
The condition grading sounds unreliable, and the price is not alot lower than refurbished iphone 13's graded as 'good' on other sites (including ones with longer warranties and the option to select colour). Seems kinda iffy as to whether this is a 'deal'
[TaylorN] I bought one today. No visible defects, 90% battery.
[DingoBlue] In theory iPhone 13 should be great but mine was a turd
[lonewolf] Not sure i will recommend the coles mobile phones. Last time i bought one , it was direct to car boot service. took it home, it was some bashed up random phone, not an iphone. Took it back and got an iphone . Battery life was…ok… , i think better off buying a lower model new phone.
[CWsniffa] two years ago purchased a 13 pro max on marketplace for $350AUD. I can't justify any of the new or refurb pricing now. It has ruined me.
[tight 10000] page shows $379…seems to have gone up to $499 at the last stage of the cart.
Maybe was a pricing error
[Dyl] Has been this price for a few months, seen it a couple of months back
No USB-C is a dealbreaker for me though
